scope: Real touchscreen AUTO start/stop, queued second round, rules cancellation and lifecycle cancellation. Real generator and settlement; deterministic no-feature/no-win sequences selected only in isolated test contexts, welcome benefit disabled there. No user save affected.

checks: Stop during rolling completes one round with no queued debit
AUTO starts the next round once; stop prevents a third
Rules stops AUTO and restores input on close
Background/foreground resumes the current round without restarting AUTO
Return to salon preserves stopped state
